goal: Event-Level Causal Identity Association: Safe One-Click Intervention with Fresh-Sequence Generalization for Online MOT
pilot_selection: First three in inherited frozen FIT order, before candidate effects; all three retained regardless of density/quality/outcome

candidate_generation.source: scripts/n72r20r2_candidate_stream.py; unchanged official SAM3 and frozen OSNet implementations
candidate_generation.confirmation_generation: NOT_RUN until freeze; integrity/unlabelled preprocessing only is authorized

initialization.rule: First valid observation per GT identity, sorted by (first_frame, identity); first three identities per video, min width16 and height48. Sole GT-defined RGB anchor at that first frame; strict one-to-one IoU>=.5 current-candidate match required. Failure retained with no replacement and no future coverage selection.
initialization.GT_role: Offline simulated human click only; identity labels in separate offline truth file
initialization.historical_reproduction: Exact historical initialization, candidate tapes, checkpoint and original operating point; no new seed refit

event_supervision.unit: Sequence/sole-click/policy causal decision boundary, not all propagated frames
event_supervision.onset_dedup: Contiguous same-cause intervals are one event. New event only at new direct action/prestate recovery/reappearance boundary. Record first divergence and all propagated frame N01/N10 separately.
event_supervision.runtime_sampling: First valid postclick frame plus every16 frames and current causal state/action/ownership/availability changes. No future truth in runtime sampling.
event_supervision.offline_long_branch_sampling: First chronological eligible onset per class per episode plus up to8 further evenly spaced eligible onsets/class. Preserve beneficial, harmful, ambiguous, competitive and no-positive classes; no best-effect selection.
event_supervision.counterfactual: Independent cloned same prestate, full global solve and branch-owned future state, one-shot then KEEP diagnostics explicitly separate from adaptive on-policy branches

relational_trigger: Simple trained models fail and measured competitor-ownership/global-regret conditional errors identify a representation deficit; preregister specific structure before fitting
selection: FIT-only fitting/normalization. INNER-only safety-first epoch/threshold/model selection: nonvacuity and harm constraints first, then paired macro HOTA, AssA, IDF1; deterministic name tie-break. All seeds retained and averaged within video. Historical8 not selection substitutes. CONFIRM/VAL/TEST never tune.

gates.G0: Current-candidate-only GT-free causal sole-click full global unique ownership, original hard-negative and explicit NONE constraints, state clone isolation, exact KEEP/A-A and pinned TrackEval reproduction

G1.severe_harm_definition: An intervention newly breaks an own-KEEP-correct other person's identity for>=20 future frames in H100

G2.cluster_CI: 2000 paired video bootstrap resamples, seed730104; average seeds/clicks within video. Report95%CI separately from numerical gates, no frame/seed-as-independent inference.

gates.G3: Exactly one untouched CONFIRM8 evaluation after model/code/checkpoint/threshold freeze; same G0/G1/G2 and full nine metrics. No correction/reselection using confirmation effects.

G4.risk_uncertainty: Event/identity/video-cluster95%CI; few zero-error writes do not establish population2% safety

memory.M_A: C0 plus actual changing memory with ZERO association authority; measure independent recognition
memory.M_B: Only safe TRAIN-qualified authority plus memory

density.whole_video_rule: At least80% of original frames in one stratum, else MIXED. Freeze from candidate counts before policy effects. GT density diagnostic separate and CONFIRM truth remains sealed.
density.masked_metrics: POSTHOC only, original frame axis/public IDs retained; never represented as full-policy generalization

resource_policy.cleanup: Project-owned regenerable temporary files only, validated exact targets and recorded dry-run before deletion; no unique historical assets

publication: Code/tests and necessary compact documentation only; local bulk candidates/checkpoints/traces/media excluded. Non-force new branch publication verified by fresh remote HEAD equals clean local HEAD. API fallback authorized.
